latest_release.body:
> **Release candidate of 0.1.0.** Please test it and report problems before the final release.


- Initial release candidate

## What's Changed
* Use Switchbrew's official names for Switch 2 HLE services and commands by @Takoroka in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/756
* dist: install Linux desktop files under dev.eglantine.eglantine by @yourlin in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/764
* Switchbrew names by @Takoroka in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/611
* Remember MKW settings and skip the command-line prompt by @Mcm190 in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/697
* Fix Mario Kart World grass rendering by @snowstormxd in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/783
* nx2: Ocarina of Time stability, shader fixes, async shader pipeline and GPU-thread optimizations (replaces #769) by @A-Man-With-A-Plan-dev in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/794
* A proper Nix flake by @Octelly in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/790
* fsp: throttle Switch 2 storage reads at 100 MB/s instead of not at all by @rdenno in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/816
* Star Fox: fix black docked cutscenes and missing menu letters by @rdenno in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/785
* fix msvc compile by @aidankinzett in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/822
* video_core: Fix shader cache folder creation for MKW by @failaip12 in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/812
* vulkan: skip pipelines the driver refuses, harden texture cache and query copies by @MythosOfs in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/720
* Revert "vulkan: skip pipelines the driver refuses, harden texture cache and query copies" by @PastaLaPate in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/828
* Revert "video_core: Fix shader cache folder creation for MKW" by @PastaLaPate in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/829
* nx2: fix -Wself-assign-field in nx2_timeline.h (macOS build) by @aidankinzett in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/826
* Fix nx2-experimental on macos by @aidankinzett in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/830
* qt_common: Fix mkw cache menu paths by @failaip12 in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/832
* system: Fix Custom RTC Date offset calculation and UI feedback loop by @Amnesia1000 in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/808
* vulkan: clamp framebuffers to device limits on macOS by @shpontex in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/775
* nx2: async shader translation, compute pre-compilation, frame spike recorder; cold hints off by default by @kraibse in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/825
* Add a built-in MCP server for AI agents (off by default) by @Quixomatic in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/421
* [UI] Reworking the recommended setting popup for MKW, OOT, others. + Moving settings around in the UI by @kraibse in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/837
* Fix/shader warm precompile archives for fefw by @aidankinzett in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/823
* qt: enable Qt translations by default and support external language files by @Amnesia1000 in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/819
* qt: allow restoring recommended settings prompts from the game menu by @Mcm190 in https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/800

detail.readme:
Eglantine

Eglantine is a free and opensource (FOSS) Switch 2 emulator, derived from Eden, Yuzu and Sudachi - started by developer Djihad Mahboubi. It's written in C++ with portability in mind, with builds for Windows, Linux and macOS

Compatibility | Development | Building | Download | Support | License

## Compatibility The emulator is capable of running Mario Kart World at full speed on most specs, Splatoon Raiders and OOT also run fine. A list of supported games will be available in future. Please be patient. ## Development For development discussions, please join us on [Discord](https://discord.gg/XkS5NVPTUY) If you would like to contribute, we are open to new developers and pull requests. Please ensure that your work is of a high standard and properly documented. You can also contact any of the developers on Discord or Stoat to learn more about the current state of the emulator. ## Documentation We have a user manual! See our [User Handbook](./docs/user/README.md). ## Building See the [General Build Guide](docs/Build.md) For information on provided development tooling, see the [Tools directory](./tools) ## Download You can download the latest releases from [here](https://github.com/Djihads80/Eglantine/releases). ## Support We currently take donations on [Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/eglantine-community). If you don't have money you can still support us by joining the [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/XkS5NVPTUY) Contributions are voluntary donations. They do not buy features, priority support, early access, bug fixes or any influence over the roadmap. Roadmap decisions stay with the maintainers. We do not accept contributions that are tied to, or conditioned on, anything that would facilitate piracy or break the law. Eglantine does not distribute copyrighted games, firmware, encryption keys or any other proprietary Nintendo material, and we do not ask or encourage anyone to share them. Eglantine is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Nintendo. ## Star History ## License Eglantine is licensed under the GPLv3 (or any later version). Refer to the [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/blob/nx2/LICENSE.txt) file.
